        # Iterate over each element in the current chunk
        for j in range(begin - 1, (i + 1) * chunk_size):
            # Update minE if a[j] is smaller
            if a[j] < minE:
                minE = a[j]
            
            # Check if |a[j] - j| >= abs(mid - minE)
            if abs(a[j] - j) >= abs(mid - minE):
                # If |a[j] - j| > maxVal, update maxVal and reset cntMax
                if abs(a[j] - j) > maxVal:
                    maxVal = abs(a[j] - j)
                    cntMax = 1
                # If |a[j] - j| == maxVal, increment cntMax
                elif abs(a[j] - j) == maxVal:
                    cntMax += 1
        
        # Update begin to point to the start of the next chunk
        begin = (i + 1) * chunk_size + 1
    
    # If cntMax is still 0, return -1
    if cntMax == 0:
        return -1
    else:
        return cntMax
